manaNeeded: {4}{G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: Tree of Redemption does not have summoning sickness.
description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Storvald either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
Storvald enters the battlefield, causing Tree or Redemption's power and toughness to become one until end of turn.
Activate Tree of Redemption by tapping it, causing your life total to become one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.
